rule: Adding time has two named verbs the donor uses without naming: affect and append spend the duration onto the buff (adds to the remaining time); prolong postpones, keeping the larger time. Every add is scaled by target.resist(class), which halves once per matching resist class. Speed multiplies per buff (Cripple /2, Dread x2, Haste x3, and others). Slow halves time spent; Chill's speed factor applies only when Slow is absent. Weakness multiplies outgoing damage before armour; Vulnerable multiplies incoming damage after armour. Paralysis is a build-up: each hit adds to it and a roll of build-up against HP decides a wake; the build-up decays by a tenth per free turn. Knockback distance is min(travel, power) with power halved (rounded up) for bosses; a collision deals rng(d, 2d) and stuns for 1 + d/2 turns. Fear (Terror, Dread) is one shared buff per target: a hit shortens it by five; Dread counts down and removes a far unseen mob; the mob flees while it lasts and turns to hunt on its end if its enemy is visible.

keep: Two named add verbs (additive for stacking, refresh for keep-the-larger), chosen per caller
Wake-up build-up roll for a stun: hits raise the chance to wake, free turns lower it
Knockback distance resolved before damage and stun; stun scales with distance
Fear breaks into rage when it ends with a visible enemy; caster death ends the fear
Single shared fear per target with one owner, so a crowd cannot stack it
change: Defect: resist comment says resists do not stack, code halves once per matching class (Char.java 1359 vs 1372). Fix: one written rule (one halving per distinct source) with a floor at a quarter, held in data.
The two add verbs are picked per caller with no name at the call site (ElementalBlast.java 285 uses affect; Sunray.java 116 uses prolong). Fix: name them stack and refresh in our API.
Far unseen fear removal (Dread.java 63) is a despawn: move to zone population (row 23), not the status step
Item destruction from statuses (Frost potions, Burning scrolls) breaks the one-ledger rule; do not port
Halved experience on fear removal (Dread.java 65) is a reward rule; keep only if zone population sets the reward
look_test: Phone, 375 wide, about 5 minutes: one duel against a single heavy enemy. Style flag on the existing scene: ?addPolicy=additive or ?addPolicy=refresh. Cast fear, then a second cast before the first ends. additive makes the counter climb past its normal length; refresh holds it at the cap. Compare two 20-second clips for piling on versus topped up. Then one wall push on a paralysed enemy: does the stun number and the wake chance read clearly? Publish the flag to the preview folder with no release rows and no lock.
